event_data.context: Baseline: eventcore-v2.1.0 (fea3e386cce904e9ef9b76cd303926870d04a692). PR #4 adds the immutable filesystem journal with atomic append, locking, reopen, configurable sync and integrity reporting. Signed f8d88e8 passed the full local gate (14 tests). Waiting for exact-revision CI and App review. Replica convergence, SQL adapters and snapshots remain open.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Durable storage and command state
